volleyball.note: Existing user-provided project asset; source attribution and license remain those of the original asset. No download.

room.source: Locally authored metre-scale architecture, plaster materials and decorative geometry in scene_environment.py
room.reference: Existing scripts/models/cloe_room.glb and scripts scene organization were reviewed; the room GLB is not loaded by this scene. Cabinet, books and ceramic vase are locally authored.

current_floor.description: Restore the original photographed worn oak floor texture and original floor_material shader; locally copied asset.

foliage.note: Uses the existing model and original materials. Asset rights and attribution remain those of the supplied original.
foliage.note_usage: No longer loaded: the corner the ball rebounds into is left empty, so the scene builds no planter and imports no foliage.

paintings.transform: Uniform scale and rigid rotation only; original mesh proportions and textures retained
paintings.note: The glb stacks three pictures on one shared 0.49 x 0.33 m mesh that differ only in texture. wall_picture_2, a copper mug on a flat blush ground, is the one hung on the left wall: at the ~30 px the comparison camera gives it, wall_picture_1's dark still life turns into a brown smudge and wall_picture_3's cream ground disappears into the plaster. Uniform scale and rigid rotation preserve the supplied proportions and textures.

air_conditioner.transform: Uniform scale 2.26 (0.531 x 0.131 x 0.181 m as supplied, 1.20 wide x 0.41 high x 0.30 deep as hung, a 3 HP size for a 240 m3 room), quarter turn about Z so the louvre faces into the room, back face 6 mm off the x=0 plaster, underside 2.40 m up and 0.90 m clear of the window's right reveal at y=3.2 m (y 4.10-5.30, top of case 2.81 m, 0.19 m below the ceiling)
air_conditioner.material_change: Metallic pinned to 0: the packed metallic channel reads 0.91 across the painted shell, which under this overcast HDR renders the unit as a blue-grey mirror instead of painted steel. Roughness still comes from the supplied map.
air_conditioner.note: Wall-mounted split indoor unit on the window wall, the one the camera sees most squarely: on the y=0 wall its face was foreshortened to 0.56 of its length (projected aspect 2.42 against a true 2.93), on x=0 seen from this camera it keeps 0.95 and projects at 2.89. It is a real static box collider in the simulator; the closest any trajectory comes is recorded per case as min_air_conditioner_clearance_m. Asset rights and attribution remain those of the supplied original.

daylight_environment.note: Existing project HDR copied locally before use; visible through real wall aperture and clear non-emissive glazing.

wood_floor_texture.note: Existing project texture, documented by the original scenes as Poly Haven wood_floor_worn. No download.

spare_volleyballs.note: Two static, standard-radius instances of the same local volleyball model; original materials retained; collision spheres match the visual size.
